title: Too na ịdọ aka ná ntị: otu mmegharị, ego nchekwa, atụmatụ ụbọchị 90
course_title: Ụmụ nwanyị ịzụ ahịa na mmepe obere azụmaahịa

say: Too na ịdọ aka ná ntị: otu ịkwaga uto, ego nchekwa, yana atụmatụ ụbọchị 90.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul atọ nke ụmụ nwanyị azụmaahịa na mmepe obere azụmaahịa.
Ọ bụghị mgbe niile ka uto na-apụta nnukwu ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ nnukwu mbinye ego. Ọ pụtara uru karịa site na azụmahịa nke ka na-aga nke ọma. Ị ga-ahọrọ otu mmegharị nke na-edozi oke oke gị.

say: Ntinye ego ọ bụla chọrọ oge nkwụghachi ụgwọ: ekewa ego ya site na uru ọzọ ọ na-eweta kwa ọnwa. Nkwụghachi ụgwọ dị mkpirikpi bụ obere ihe ize ndụ.

card.title: Aisha nwere ike ị nweta fryer nke abụọ?
card.note: Ọnụ ahịa Naira dị ihe ruru.

say: Ihe fryer nke abụọ na ọkụ gas na-efu ihe dị ka puku naira 180.

card.title: Aisha nwere ike ị nweta fryer nke abụọ?
card.note: Ọnụ ahịa Naira dị ihe ruru.

say: 3 extra order na 20,000 naira uru nke ọ bụla na-eweta 60,000 kwa ọnwa. Ya mere nkwụghachi ụgwọ bụ ọnwa 3.

card.title: Aisha nwere ike ị nweta fryer nke abụọ?
card.note: Ọnụ ahịa Naira dị ihe ruru.

say: Ego a kwụrụ na 36,000 kwa ọnwa maka ọnwa 6 pụtara na ọ kwụghachi 216,000. Nbinye ego ahụ na-efu 36,000.

card.title: Aisha nwere ike ị nweta fryer nke abụọ?
rows: Nkwụghachi ego mbinye ego kwa ọnwa
card.note: Ọnụ ahịa Naira dị ihe ruru.

say: Nke ahụ na-ahapụ 24,000 kwa ọnwa. Ugbu a ule ọnwa ọjọọ. Ọ bụrụ naanị iwu 2 ọzọ bịara, naanị 4,000 ga-ahapụ ka akwụghachichara ya.
Ya mere, Aisha na-ewere ego nkwado maka ọkara ma jiri ego nchekwa maka ndị ọzọ. Ọnwa nwayọ agaghị agbaji ya.

say: Malite na uru na ego echekwabara nke gị. Ọ na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ, ma ọ dịghị ụgwọ.

panel.heading: Ihe a ga-enyefe, ihe ị ga-edebe

say: Debe ọnụ ahịa, ndị ahịa bụ isi, nlele mma na ego. Blessing na-akwụ otu onye inyeaka puku naira iri atọ kwa ọnwa maka ịcha ncha wee were awa iri atọ ahụ ewepụtara were nweta nkwekọrịta ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ruru puku iri ise. E wezụga atụmatụ ahụ, inyefe ọrụ gaara efu ya.

panel.heading: Ihe a ga-enyefe, ihe ị ga-edebe

say: Ebumnuche SMART bụ nke akọwapụtara, enwere ike ịlele, enwere ike iru ya, dabara na ogologo oge. Blessing's: tolite site na 300 ruo 420 ihe kwa ọnwa n'ime ụbọchị 90, yana mkpesa na-erughị pasent 1.5.

say: Cheta. Gbalịa nweta mmeri ngwa ngwa tupu nnukwu nzo. Mepụta oge nkwụghachi ụgwọ, ma gbaziri naanị ma ọ bụrụ na mbinye ego gafere ule ọnwa ọjọọ.
Ọ bụrụ na ị daa n'azụ, gbanwee atụmatụ na ebumnuche wee dee ya. Ịhapụ atụmatụ dị jụụ bụ ụzọ a na-emekarị ka uto si akwụsị.

mbinye ego ga-agafe ule ọnwa ọjọọ

say: Jiri mgbako nkwụghachi ụgwọ nwalee ọganihu gị na-eto eto. Hazie otu inyefe na otu mmekorita. Wee were ezigbo ọnụọgụ dee atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 gị, akara dị ka atụmatụ ebe achọrọ ya.
Ugbu a gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
